facts.text: Stream_SendsChangesAfterTheRevision reads a first frame named revision whose SSE id is null.
Stream_SendsChangesAfterTheRevision asserts a changes frame carries the next cursor as its SSE id and the new fact text beta.
Stream_SendsChangesAfterTheRevision expects the change row to name actor dossier-cli on the facts insert.
Stream_ResumesFromLastEventId reconnects with since=0 and a Last-Event-ID header to prove the header wins over the query.
Stream_ResumesFromLastEventId asserts the resumed changes frame starts at the cursor and its first seq is cursor plus one.
Stream_SinceReplaysHistory connects with since=0 and no later write, then asserts the replay runs from 0 to the head revision.
Stream_SinceReplaysHistory asserts the replayed rows carry the texts alpha, beta and gamma in that order.
Stream_DrainsBeyondOnePage posts 450 facts in one transaction and asserts changes pages of 200, 200 and 50 rows.
Stream_DrainsBeyondOnePage asserts each changes frame starts at the previous cursor and the last cursor is baseline plus 450.
Stream_ResetsWhenThePointFellOutOfRetention prunes with retention 5 and slack 1, then asserts the second frame is a reset.
Stream_ResetsWhenThePointFellOutOfRetention asserts the reset frame data equals the store revision the first frame reported.
Stream_ResetsBeyondTheDrainCap posts 5001 facts and asserts 25 changes pages of 200 rows end in a reset frame.
Stream_EmptyTickSendsNoChangesFrame injects a revision past the journal and asserts the tick sends a revision frame and no changes frame.
Stream_EmptyTickSendsNoChangesFrame asserts an empty page leaves the journal cursor fixed so the next real write is delivered from it.
Stream_RetriesAFailedJournalReadWithoutANewWrite injects one SqliteException with code 5 and relies on a 100 millisecond keepalive to retry the read.
Stream_RetriesAFailedJournalReadWithoutANewWrite asserts the injected read failed exactly once while the retry still delivers the page.
Stream_SurvivesJournalReadFailure makes the first journal read throw and asserts a later tick still delivers the beta write.

facts.text: WaitUntilAsync polls its condition every 10 milliseconds and throws a TimeoutException once 5 seconds have passed.
ReadFramesAsync reads each line under a 20 second timeout and throws when the stream ends short of the wanted frames.
ReadFramesAsync skips SSE comment lines, which start with a colon, and closes a frame on a blank line.
The SseFrame Body property joins its data lines with newlines and parses the result as JSON.
Long parses an SSE value as an invariant-culture integer and throws when the value is missing.
at: long.Parse(text ?? throw new InvalidOperationException("missing value"), NumberStyles.Integer, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
